test_keep_alive_argument: test the keep_alive call policy to ensure child objects are kept alive when passed as arguments to parent methods
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the keep_alive call policy on return values to prevent premature garbage collection of returned child objects
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection of circular references with keep_alive policy on ParentGC objects with dynamic attributes
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the keep_alive call policy in constructors to keep the argument alive while the constructed object exists
test_call_guard: test call_guard policies including custom guards, multiple guards with correct and wrong ordering, and GIL scoped guards
